item.title: New law brings unlimited fines for dog attacks on farm animals
item.description: A new law passed today gives farm animals in England and Wales stronger protection from dog attacks, with the maximum penalty for livestock worrying – when a dog you own or are in charge of attacks or chases livestock on agricultural land – increasing from £1,000 to an unlimited fine, and police given powers to […]
